For personal technical learning. The built-in catalog references fanmingming/live (https://github.com/fanmingming/live), iptv-org/iptv, and historical Guovin/iptv-api results. Per-URL provenance is incomplete; see the project documentation. The catalog ships with the app and is not synchronized automatically.

The device requests third-party streams directly. The app does not host, relay, transcode, or record programs. Content rights remain with their holders; public access and a learning purpose do not grant authorization. Use content you are entitled to access and follow the applicable terms.

Stream URLs may fail or have network restrictions. Playback errors trigger attempts at subsequent sources. Playlist imports save a snapshot, without scheduled refresh.

The app has no accounts, analytics, or crash-reporting SDKs, and does not report favorites, history, or imported channels. Subscription downloads and playback send requests to third parties, which receive the IP address, requested URL, and related information. Local data may enter Android cloud backup or device transfer according to system settings.
